confidentialite.s1: Glamia, an appointment and payment management application for beauty professionals.
confidentialite.s2: When you book online, we collect:
confidentialite.s2l4: Services chosen, date and time of the appointment
confidentialite.s2l5: Optional comments left by the client
confidentialite.s2b: If you pay online (deposit, card on file or payment through Glamia Pay), we also collect the amount, the type and the date of the transaction, along with technical payment identifiers. Your card details are entered and processed directly by our payment provider (Stripe) and are never stored by Glamia.
confidentialite.s3: Your data is used solely for:
confidentialite.s3l1: Managing and following up your appointments
confidentialite.s3l2: Sending confirmations, reminders and email notifications about your appointments
confidentialite.s3l3: Processing payments, deposits, cards on file and refunds relating to your appointments
confidentialite.s3l4: Communication between you and your practitioner
confidentialite.s4: Processing is based on performance of the service you requested (booking and, where applicable, the associated payment), under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Retention of payment and invoicing data also meets our legal and accounting obligations (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
confidentialite.s5: Your data is kept for the duration of the commercial relationship with your practitioner, then deleted within 12 months of your last appointment.
confidentialite.s5b: Payment and invoicing data is kept for as long as our legal and accounting obligations require.
confidentialite.s6: Glamia offers your practitioner payment features — a deposit at booking, a card held on file, card payments (including without a terminal, the card being tapped on the practitioner's iPhone) and payment links — grouped under the name Glamia Pay.
confidentialite.s6b: These payments are processed by Stripe (Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd.), a provider certified as compliant with the PCI-DSS security standard. Your card details are entered and processed directly by Stripe: they never pass through Glamia and are never kept on our servers.
confidentialite.s6c: When you leave a card on file, no money is taken at booking: it is an authorisation allowing your practitioner to charge the agreed amount if you do not turn up without cancelling, under the conditions shown before payment.
confidentialite.s7: Your data is accessible only to the practitioner you book with. It is neither sold nor shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
confidentialite.s7b: We use technical providers (processors) strictly necessary for the service to work:
confidentialite.s7l1: Data hosting: Supabase (servers located in the European Union).
confidentialite.s7l2: Payments: Stripe, for secure processing of Glamia Pay transactions.
confidentialite.s7l3: Sending emails (confirmations, reminders): our emailing provider.
confidentialite.s8: Under data protection law, you have the following rights:
confidentialite.s8l1: The right to access, correct and delete your data
confidentialite.s8l3: The right to object to and restrict processing
confidentialite.s8b: To exercise your rights, contact us at:
confidentialite.s9: The Glamia booking site does not use advertising cookies. Only technical cookies necessary for the service to work are used.
